what: W39 task 2: settings.mirrorBias (D49) under @pmndrs/upscaler (NativeAA) and with AA off, FFX denoiser off / on; `runs` after W44 (main 4e4558b, hitShading reshade, the default), `preW44` before it (49dbfa7). examples/ssr 960x540, loop stopped, 8-bit luma of the displayed image, per G-buffer perceptual-roughness bin (+-0.02, eroded 2 px from bin edges; mirrorWall: floor px only after setFloorRoughness). Reference per AA mode: mean of 256 still frames, raw (denoise off), bias 0. still: 60 warm frames then 32: std (temporal), flicker (mean |x_t - x_t-1|), bias (RMS of mean - ref, finite-sample noise removed), rmse (one frame vs ref). moving: pendulum orbit 0.1 deg/frame (5 frames each way, 4 legs per pass) through the start pose, 12 passes; rmse / bias / std of the frames at the start pose (camera still moving) vs ref; d2 = |second difference| inside each leg, mean and % > 4/255.
